🚀 Product
Lead Story · Pricing + GTM

Payroll Price Update — What Sales Needs Before July 15

Homebase Payroll pricing is moving for new sign-ups only. This is the issue's must-read: know who is impacted, who is excluded, and exactly how to frame the value story.

$49 + $6
Payroll price for new sign-ups
Jul 15
Phase 1 live date
SFDC first
Source of truth before quoting
Rule #1: Always check Salesforce before quoting. Current Payroll customers, Spring Promo sign-ups through July 15, active bundled customers, brand partners, legacy package customers, and accounts with open Payroll opportunities stay on existing pricing for now.
🎓 Open training slides 📄 Download one-pager 🔗 Open comms plan
Training slide — pricing overview
Internal sales one-pager — click to expand
✅
What sales needs to know: Payroll moves to $49/mo + $6 per paid employee for new sign-ups on July 15. Next Day Pay moves to $59/mo + $9 per paid employee. Current Payroll customers are not changing in Phase 1.
💡
Why it’s happening/changing: This is the first Payroll pricing update since 2022 and is being framed around the value of Payroll bundled with scheduling and time tracking in one platform.
🗣️
How it impacts day-to-day: Do not lead with “price increase.” Lead with value, check Salesforce before quoting, and escalate edge cases like EIN changes, business sales, or new-location confusion instead of improvising.
Talk-track anchor: “For about 33¢ more per day, customers get payroll, scheduling, and time tracking together — one platform, one login, one bill.”
New Feature · Coming Jul 27

Schedule Builder Agent — AI Draft Schedules for Empty Weeks

A new opt-in AI scheduling mode will generate a draft schedule when a manager opens an unpublished, empty week in Schedule Builder on OAM Web.

🔗 Source thread 🎨 Figma visual resource
Opt-in prompt: managers can let Schedule Builder create the draft for an empty week.
Draft ready: PTO requests, availability gaps, stale availability, and new team members are reviewed before assigning shifts.
Missing availability: the agent flags team members who have not submitted availability yet.
Stale availability: the agent highlights availability that has not been updated in 45+ days.
New team members: the agent flags employees with no availability or role before scheduling them.
Drafted schedule: managers review coverage, hour caps, and rest warnings before publishing.
Change review panel: a compact summary of assignments changed, open shifts, and hours to review.
🤖
What sales needs to know: The agent creates a full draft schedule based on roles and recent scheduling patterns, then asks managers to review conflicts before publishing.
🧩
Why it’s happening/changing: Building a weekly schedule from scratch is a high-effort task. SBA removes the blank canvas so managers can review and refine instead of starting from zero.
📅
How it impacts day-to-day: Tell customers this is opt-in, standard Schedule Builder is unchanged, and V1 is a starting point — managers should expect to review and edit before publishing.
Rollout: phased launch begins July 27, targeting full rollout by about August 3. Mobile is not in scope for V1.
🛠 CS Ops
New Feature · Live

Balancing Payroll Visibility & Variance Notification

Payroll customers can now monitor quarterly tax variance status before quarter-end recap documents are finalized.

🔗 Source thread 🎨 Figma visual resource
Tax Filings view — Balancing payroll status, refund/debit amount, and download path
👀
What sales needs to know: Customers can see balancing payroll status in Payroll → Tax records → Tax Filings for Q4 2025 and later quarters.
🧾
Why it’s happening/changing: Previously, customers had little in-quarter visibility into expected tax overpayments or underpayments until quarterly recap docs were finalized.
🛠️
How it impacts day-to-day: If customers ask about a debit, refund, or failed balancing payroll, route them to Tax Filings or the dashboard task. Failed cases can retry ACH or wire funds from the resolution flow.
Support framing: Draft, processing, pending, and paid statuses usually require no action. Failed status does require the customer to resolve payment before tax filings/payments may proceed.
Functionality Update · Live

Missed Break Corrections — Skip Optional Meal Breaks

Managers can now keep Missed Break Corrections on while reducing clock-out checklist noise from optional unpaid meal breaks.

🔗 Source thread
Settings path — Breaks & Compliance → Break settings → Skip optional meal breaks
⚙️
What sales needs to know: A new sub-toggle appears under Missed break corrections: Skip optional meal breaks. It only appears when MBC is enabled.
🧹
Why it’s happening/changing: Customers with multiple optional unpaid breaks were seeing long clock-out checklists. This limits prompts to mandatory breaks without turning MBC off.
📱
How it impacts day-to-day: If a manager says clock-out prompts are too long, point them to the new toggle. If an employee says optional breaks stopped appearing, confirm the manager enabled it.
Default behavior: OFF. Nothing changes until an OAM opts in. Rollout flag: mbc_mandatory_only.
New Report · Live

Payroll Department Breakdown Report — CSV Cost Allocation

Active Payroll customers now have a Department Breakdown CSV report that shows payroll cost split by department when employees work across multiple areas.

🔗 Source thread
Where to find it — Standard Reports + payroll run download menu
CSV output — one row per employee × department × pay period
📊
What sales needs to know: The new CSV mirrors the Location Breakdown report but splits payroll cost by department. It is available to all active payroll customers.
🏷️
Why it’s happening/changing: Customers with floaters or multi-role employees need labor costs allocated to where work actually happened, not collapsed to one department per paycheck.
🧭
How it impacts day-to-day: Point customers to Payroll → Reports → Standard Reports or payroll history/run download menus for Department breakdown (CSV).
Important caveat: This is a reporting tool only. It does not change paycheck calculations or payroll journals; journals may still show one department per employee.
📣 PMM
Partnership Note

New Tea-Based Franchise Partnerships — Sharetea + UG Tea

Two tea-based franchise motions now have approved bundle, promo, coupon, and support details in the Franchise Partnerships Bundles KB.

🔗 Open bundle pricing doc
🧋
What sales needs to know: Sharetea and UG Tea both have three approved bundle options: Plus + Payroll, Plus + Payroll + Tip Manager, and Plus + Payroll + Hiring.
💸
Why it’s happening/changing: These partnership bundles waive the Payroll base fee across the listed packages; franchisees pay the per-employee Payroll fee alongside the approved per-location bundle price.
📌
How it impacts day-to-day: Use the KB before discussing pricing, coupons, or packages. Support routes through franchise-support@joinhomebase.com and the listed phone support path.
Do not freestyle franchise pricing. Use the linked KB for the latest coupons, package admin links, promos, and support model details.
